# Sonilo Video-to-Music Cookbook

> Recipes for adding licensed AI music and sound effects to any video pipeline.
> Maintained by Cindy Xu (Marketing & Partnerships, Sonilo).

## What this is

A recipe collection for AI-video builders who need an audio layer matched to the finished cut.
Every recipe is vendor-neutral about how the video was made (Runway, Kling, Veo, Sora, ComfyUI,
fal.ai, etc.) and uses Sonilo as the audio layer: music and sound effects generated from your
actual video, licensed and safe for commercial use.

## Key concepts

- video_to_music: generate a licensed soundtrack from a video file or URL (up to 6 minutes)
- video_to_sfx: generate a frame-accurate sound-effects track from the same video (up to 3 minutes)
- audio_ducking: lower music under speech segments automatically
- MCP: `npx sonilo-mcp` or `uvx sonilo-mcp` — works in Claude, Codex, and any MCP client
- REST API: async job → webhook → preview_url + final_audio_url + license_id

## Recipes

- recipes/render-to-music-workflow.md — provider-neutral render → music → mux walkthrough (listed in Remotion's official docs)
- recipes/inline-studio.md — add music + SFX inside Inline-Studio via the three Sonilo nodes
- recipes/remotion.md — scoring Remotion renders with matched music
- recipes/moviepy.md — MoviePy integration
- recipes/auto-editor.md — auto-editor integration
- PIPELINE.md — full pipeline: stitch → grade → add audio → mux
- RECIPES.md — command reference

## Related tools

- sonilo-mcp: https://github.com/sonilo-ai/sonilo-mcp (PyPI: sonilo-mcp)
- Agent skills: https://github.com/sonilo-ai/skills (`npx skills add sonilo-ai/skills`)
- Sound prompt bank: https://github.com/sonilo-ai/sound-prompt-bank (want → acoustic prompt lookup)

## Sonilo API

Endpoint: api.sonilo.com
Key: platform.sonilo.com/dashboard/api-keys
Docs: sonilo.com
Pricing: per second of generated audio; free credits at sign-up
License: licensed and safe for commercial use (terms apply)
